misconceptions.trigger: Confusing 'Iqta' with direct ownership of land
misconceptions.explanation: Students often think an 'Iqtadar' owned the land given to him.
misconceptions.correction: An 'Iqta' was a grant of the right to collect revenue from a territory in exchange for military service. The Iqtadar (Muqti) did not own the land and could be transferred.
